name: Discovery Museum Camps
description_short: Half-day weekly camps at the Shenandoah Valley Discovery Museum, running mornings 9am-12pm or afternoons 1pm-4pm, Monday to Friday. Topics are picked and led by counselors, and each day includes a snack and at least 30 minutes of play in the museum. Camps are for rising PreK/K (age 4+) through grade 5.

Price is $150 per camp (a Monday to Friday half-day week). It is recorded as price_per_week, but it covers only a 3-hour daily block. A morning and an afternoon camp together would cost $300 plus the optional $25 lunch bunch. Premier Members get $25 off per camp.
The 'lunch bunch' extended hour is only offered 'in some instances,' and only for children registered for both morning and afternoon camps.
Grade range is for 'rising' grade level. The youngest group is PreK/K (4+), so grade_min is not recorded as a number.
